SELECT ics30_compliance_id AS compliance_id, ics30_company_id AS company_id, ics30_start_date AS start_date, ics30_compliance_type AS compliance_type, f_cdnm('IcsComplianceType', ics30_compliance_type, ics30_company_id, #{stdDate}) AS compliance_type_name, ics30_sub_num AS sub_num, ics30_content AS content, ics30_na_use_yn AS na_use_yn, ics31_compliance_write_id AS compliance_write_id, ics31_answer_cd AS answer_code, ics31_reason AS reason, COALESCE(ics31_fix_yn,'false') = 'true' AS fix_yn, COALESCE(ics31_confirm_yn,'false') = 'true' AS confirm_yn, f_emp_kor_nm(ics31_confirmer_id) AS confirmer_name, f_emp_kor_nm(ics31_person_id) AS person_name, f_get_empTrans(ics31_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') AS org_name FROM ics30_compliance LEFT OUTER JOIN ics31_compliance_write ON ( ics31_compliance_id = ics30_compliance_id AND ics31_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics31_person_id = #{personId} AND ics31_cycle_type = #{cycleType} AND ics31_yyyymm = TO_CHAR(#{stdDate}::date,'YYYY.MM') ) WHERE 1=1
AND ics31_answer_cd IS NULL
AND ics30_company_id = #{companyId} AND #{stdDate}::date <= COALESCE(ics30_use_close_date, '9999-12-31'::date) AND ics30_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.ics30_start_date) FROM ics30_compliance x WHERE x.ics30_company_id = #{companyId} AND x.ics30_start_date <= #{stdDate} AND COALESCE(x.ics30_date_fix_yn,'false') = 'true' ) AND CONCAT(ics30_content) LIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY ics30_compliance_type, ics30_sub_num

SELECT ics31_compliance_write_id AS compliance_write_id, ics31_compliance_id AS compliance_id, ics31_answer_cd AS answer_code, ics31_reason AS reason, COALESCE(ics31_fix_yn,'false') = 'true' AS fix_yn, COALESCE(ics31_confirm_yn,'false') = 'true' AS confirm_yn FROM ics31_compliance_write INNER JOIN ics30_compliance ON ( ics30_compliance_id = ics31_compliance_id AND ics30_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(ics30_start_date) FROM ics30_compliance WHERE ics30_compliance_id = ics31_compliance_id AND ics30_start_date <= #{stdDate} ) ) WHERE ics31_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics31_person_id = #{personId} AND ics31_yyyymm = TO_CHAR(#{stdDate}::date,'YYYY.MM') AND ics31_cycle_type = #{cycleType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ics31_compliance_write ( ics31_compliance_write_id, ics31_company_id, ics31_compliance_id, ics31_yyyymm, ics31_person_id, ics31_answer_cd, ics31_write_datetime, ics31_cycle_type ) VALUES ( #{complianceWriteId}, #{companyId}, #{complianceId}, #{yyyymm}, #{personId}, #{answerCode}, f_sysdate(), #{cycleType} )
